decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The use of the premises shown as shop unit B on the submitted plans Nos.1, 3 and 6 of 6, shall be as a restaurant or caf?, for the sale of food for consumption on the premises in accordance with Class A3 'Restaurants and Cafes' of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes Order) 1987 (As Amended 2005).

Condition : 3 - The proposed kitchen extraction system shall comprise, as indicated an electrostatic precipitator (model ESP3000E) and an odour neutraliser (Model O.N.100) which shall be routinely cleaned and maintained in accordance with the manufacturer's, Purified Air, recommendations, with the baffle filters being cleaned daily and the entire system being serviced monthly or at whatever interval is in accordance with the manufacturers recommendations.  In addition, the ducting shall be isolated from the building structure, the fan unit shall be mounted on anti-vibrational mountings, and fan silencers shall be incorporated. The duct shall also be provided and shall discharge as shown on drawings Nos.5 and 6 received 25th August 2006.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers on any day outside the following times - 11am to 11pm.
Condition : 5 - No amplified music audible outside the premises shall be played on the premises between 11pm and 8am on any day.
Condition : 6 - No deliveries shall be taken at the site outside the hours between 7am and 9pm on any day.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the information given of disabled access and of the proposed shopfront design on the submitted plans, detailed drawings, at a scale of 1:20, to show the proposed shopfront (including materials to be used), and to include the means of access for the ambulant disabled, and manoeuvrability of a wheelchair within the restaurant, shall be submitted to and shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the development being commenced, and the details which may be approved shall be implemented and provided on the first bringing into use of the A3 restaurant use, and shall thereafter be retained.

Condition : 8 - The details of customer car parking in the rear service yard shall be provided as indicated on the submitted drawing No.1 of 6, except that car parking space No.4 shall be omitted and spaces Nos.1 and 2 shall be 2.4 metres wide and the disabled space No.3 shall be 3.6 metres wide.  In addition, the sliding gates to the rear parking area shall remain open at all times between the hours of 11am and 11pm.
Condition : 9 - The refuse storage facilities shall be provided as indicated on the submitted drawing No.1 of 6 on the first bringing into use of the restaurant and shall thereafter be retained.
Condition : 10 - The existing crossover to the premises on Gould Road shall be removed and the pavement re-instated prior to the new vehicular access being provided.
description: Change of use of retail unit from A1 to part A1 and part A3 restaurant, together with external alterations to provide extract duct, and formation of vehicular access to Gould Road with new entrance gates.
